rag.text:
Test: TC-4859 — Feature area - Exporting - Exporting and then Importing tasks without dates from same file - CSV
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-94 Feature area - Exporting
Labels: teamembers, teamscheduling

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4296 Feature area - Exporting - Exporting and then Importing tasks without dates from same file - CSV - Export
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. 9 tasks are displayed on gantt chart and WBS.

* Bug1 - no start date
* Bug2 - no end date
* Bug3 - no start & end date
* Story1 - no start date
* Story2 - no end date
* Story3 - no start & end date
* Task1 - no start date
* Task2 - no end date
* Task3 - no start & end date
2. Click the Export button in the module's header
   Expected: Export manager is displayed, with following options available:

* Export to image (PDF) Range dropdown ("Full scope" option is displayed as default)
* Export to CSV (CSV)
* MS Excel export (XLSX)
* MS Project Empty Template - MPP, MPX, PDF, XML
3. Export to CSV and check if data in file is correct
   Expected: Export to CSV and check if data in file is correct
4. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4296 Feature area - Exporting - Exporting and then Importing tasks without dates from same file - CSV - Import
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. Splash screen is displayed with two tiles:  Create new, Define scope
5. Click "+Add task" dropdown
   Expected: Dropdown is expanded. Following options are available:
- Create task
Create sub-task (disabled)
- Manage scope definition
- Import tasks from file
- Clone existing scope
6. Select "Import tasks from file" option
   Expected: Modal window is displayed with following fields:
- Add an import file containing tasks to be imported
- Select the Jira project where the tasks will be created

In modal window is switcher "Convert parent tasks to Jira Epics" and it is in off position.
7. Upload the file that has been downloaded after clicking export
   Expected: File is uploaded. "Map the columns " section appears. Columns from file are correctly mapped to all corresponding task fields
8. Select projectName in modal window
   Data: projectName: TC-4296B Feature area - Exporting - Exporting tasks without dates - Import
   Expected: Select the Jira project where the tasks will be created is set to "TC-4296B Feature area - Exporting - Exporting tasks without dates - Import"
9. Click "Import" button
   Expected: Confirmation dialog with message" Imported tasks will be added gradually. Refresh the page so that you can observe the results. " appears.
10. Click "Proceed" button
   Expected: Import file modal is closed.
11. Refresh the page when the following message appears: "Tasks have been successfully imported. Now you can refresh the page to see your tasks."
   Expected: Tasks become visible.
12. Expand all tasks by arrow down next to column Summary
   Expected: All tasks are imported. Following structure is displayed in WBS:

* Bug1 - no start date
* Bug2 - no end date
* Bug3 - no start & end date
* Story1 - no start date
* Story2 - no end date
* Story3 - no start & end date
* Task1 - no start date
* Task2 - no end date
* Task3 - no start & end date
